Gonna call this the short term top here exited that super short term bag. Mostly just tired of watching it like a hawk. $DOGE often suprises though so I deff have a longer term bag still in play if we really bubble.

oh its looking nice. buy support still building and resistance still falling. Usually my kneejerk super short term moves fail but this is going well $DOGE

I could still see $DOGE going up a bit more tonight. All depends if we got trend chasers or not. I be watching that buy support in case I gotta exit on the big blob I bought when I saw this forming up.

ya at risk of falling for a clever trap I am just gonna market buy some $DOGE right here. looks like for sure it will touch into the profit zone tonight. Just don't be super greedy on this extra blob I just got :)
ya $DOGE looks really good for a breakout right now. That buy support is just piling up making whats left of a price suppression wall look quite weak.
